ctx.x: So what other, besides Dave and Tommy, you said you were behind Fat Man Matthews?

Yeah, Tommy Ridgely, Pee Wee Creighton. Oh, you did the Pee Wee Creighton? One of them for Imperial. That was supposed to be a very important session. T-Bone Walker. I remember one tune I had a solo, and I'd like to hear it now, you better go now, yours too. For T-Bone? No, it was Pee Wee Creighton. Pee Wee Creighton, yeah.
